name: containerlab-app
description: Monorepo for Containerlab web, desktop, VS Code extension, and shared UI.

scripts.vsix: pnpm ui && pnpm --filter vscode-containerlab run package
scripts.web: pnpm ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-app-web run build
scripts.web:local: pnpm ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-app-web run dev
scripts.desktop: pnpm ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-desktop run package
scripts.desktop:local: pnpm ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-desktop run dev
scripts.pages: pnpm ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-app-web run build:pages
scripts.pages:local: pnpm ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-app-web run dev:pages
scripts.typecheck: pnpm ui && pnpm check && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm ui && node --test scripts/release-targets.test.mjs && pnpm -r --if-present run test:unit
scripts.test:web: pnpm ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-app-web run test:e2e
scripts.test:vscode: pnpm ui && pnpm --filter vscode-containerlab run test:e2e
